newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Omega plans 1-for-3 rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Omega plans 1-for-3 rights issue.

text.p: Stockbroking concern Omega Holdings Bhd has proposed a one-for-three rights issue of up to 38.185 million new shares to be priced at 4.30 ringgit each.
Omega said in a statement on Wednesday that proceeds of the rights issue totalling 164.20 million ringgit would be used as working capital and for repayment of bank borrowings.

The proposed rights issue will increase Omega's paid-up capital to 152.741 million shares of 1.0 ringgit from 109.529 currently. Group net tangible assets per share will rise to 3.76 ringgit from 3.43.
Omega shares closed at 7.05 ringgit on Wednesday.
